name: Scheme for Providing Counseling to the Trainees of Government Industrial Training Institutes at Directorate of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship
benefit:
##### ***Provision of Counseling Services***

- Youth-friendly counseling services are provided to assist distressed students to think more clearly and positively and develop the skills required to find their way forward.

_eligibility_text: ##### ***Eligibility for the Trainee (The Applicant)*** - The applicant must be a trainee studying in Government Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) under the Directorate of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (DSDE) in the State of Goa. ##### ***Eligibility for the Counselor Profile*** - The applicant must not exceed the age limit of 45 years. - The applicant must possess a Regular Masters degree in Clinical/Counseling Psychology OR Masters in Social Work (MSW) with specialization in medical and psychiatric. - OR The applicant must possess a Regular Graduation in Psychology (6 units), Social Work, or Home Science (Human Resources) from a University Grants Commission (UGC) recognized College and a Diploma in Guidance and Counseling from a recognized Institution. - The applicant must have a minimum of 1 year experience in Counseling. - The applicant must possess a 15 years residence certificate. - The applicant must possess knowledge of Konkani. - The applicant should possess knowledge of Marathi. ##### ***Eligibility for the Supervisor Profile*** - The applicant must not exceed the age limit of 45 years. - The applicant must possess a Regular Masters Degree in Clinical/Counseling Psychology OR Masters in Social Work (MSW) with specialization in medical and psychiatric. - The applicant must possess a Diploma in Guidance and Counseling from a recognized institution. - The applicant must have a minimum of 3 years experience in Counselling. - The applicant must have experience of conducting training and workshops. - The applicant must possess a 15 years residence certificate. - The applicant must possess knowledge of Konkani. - The applicant should possess knowledge of Marathi. - The applicant should possess a Master of Philosophy (M. Phil) or Doctor of Philosophy (Ph. D.) in Psychology. ##### ***Eligibility for the Data Entry Operator Profile*** - The applicant must not exceed the age limit of 45 years. - The applicant must have passed the Higher Secondary School Certificate Examination (HSSCE) from a recognized Institution. - The applicant must possess a certificate confirming completion of a course in Computer for a minimum period of 3 months from a recognized Institute. - The applicant must possess a 15 years residence certificate. - The applicant must possess knowledge of Konkani. - The applicant should possess knowledge of Marathi.
